description: Historical Flood Events (HFE) is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Natural Resources Canada | Ressources naturelles Canada. Representation of the causes of flooding events in the form of multiple points. The point groupings correspond to the set of locations that were affected by the same event. The inventory of past flooding events was compiled from various public sources and standardized into a common data model. Sources used are included in the data. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Natural Resources Canada | Ressources naturelles Canada. Its tags are EHI, HFE, FHIMP, PICAI, Flood. It offers 10 resource(s) in ESRI REST, FGDB/GDB, GPKG, PDF, WMS. The portal shows 2025-12-11 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
